name: Northeast Nebraska Community Action Partnership Inc: veteran housing help (SSVF)
organization: Northeast Nebraska Community Action Partnership Inc
description: VA-funded Supportive Services for Veteran Families (SSVF, grant 14-NE-238): case management, help keeping a home, rapid rehousing and short-term financial help for low-income veteran households. Serves: Antelope County, Burt County, Cedar County, Cuming County, Dakota County, Dixon County, Dodge County, Knox County, Madison County, Pierce County, Stanton County, Thurston County and 2 more.
next_step: Call SSVF intake with your county and housing situation: whether you are homeless now or at risk of losing housing, and who lives with you.
constraints: Serves only the areas listed; check that yours is included. Veteran-household, income and housing-status screening applies.
County and intake details come from VA’s FY26 SSVF provider intake list; confirm current service when calling.
